# authwise_guard_resource_nodes (Resource)

Manages the full set of nodes associated with one guard resource. The set is authoritative: members associated out of band are removed on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The nodes that serve a resource, as an authoritative set: a node
# associated out of band is removed on the next apply.
resource "authwise_guard_resource_nodes" "office_lan" {
  guard_resource = authwise_guard_resource.office_lan.name
  nodes          = [authwise_guard_node.gateway.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guard_resource` (String) Full resource name of the guard resource.
- `nodes` (Set of String) Full resource names of the associated nodes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the resource's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_resource_nodes.office_lan tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/resources/res-01
```
